when: a changed path matches both a shared scope and a split scope
expect: the adapter selects exactly the union of the matching area files

when: the full run is requested with no affected paths
expect: every indexed area executes

when: an implementation changes outside the scoped selection
expect: the full run fails on the drifted row

when: the spec index has no rows
expect: the adapter fails instead of passing as verified

when: an indexed area file has no rows
expect: the adapter fails instead of passing as verified

when: two index entries name the same path
expect: the adapter fails instead of deduplicating silently

when: a row's expected value is edited on disk
expect: the adapter fails the assertion

when: a row carries an ID the adapter has no branch for
expect: the adapter rejects the ID

when: Python runs with optimization enabled
expect: the adapter refuses to run

when: an area file holds more than 40 rows
expect: the adapter requires a split

when: the changed paths together select every indexed area
expect: every area file is read

when: an implementation file changes so a row's expected value no longer holds
expect: the adapter fails and names the row, the expected value and the actual value

when: a row's input is edited on disk
expect: the edited input reaches the implementation and the result changes with it

when: two rows carry the same ID
expect: the adapter fails with duplicate spec IDs before executing any row

when: `--all` is combined with affected paths
expect: the adapter fails

when: an index entry's row count differs from its area file
expect: the adapter fails with a row count mismatch

when: the adapter gets no affected paths and no `--all`
expect: it fails and asks for the scope to be clarified

when: the adapter's execution loop skips a row
expect: it fails and lists the unexecuted row

when: a path matches one area only
expect: the other area files are not opened

when: the same path is given twice, or two paths select the same area
expect: each row executes once

when: an index scope is a glob
expect: it matches repository-relative paths

when: a path matches a scope shared by several areas
expect: the shared area is selected and area files outside the selection are ignored

when: an affected path matches no index scope, alone or beside a matching path
expect: the adapter fails and names the unmatched path
